facts.fact: ARCEP Gabon says Gabon signed a roaming protocol of agreement with the Central African Republic in 2021; opening is planned short term.
ARCEP Gabon says Gabon has opened free roaming with Cameroon, in operation on the Gabon side only.
ARCEP Gabon says Gabon and Congo signed roaming protocols, with SMS and data added in 2021.
ARCEP Gabon says free roaming with Congo went into service for voice on 15 October 2019 and was extended to SMS and data.
Gabon's regulator ARCEP says Gabon signed roaming protocols of agreement with Congo, the Central African Republic and Chad in 2021, under the CEMAC regulation.
ARCEP Gabon says Gabon has opened free roaming with Rwanda, Congo, Togo and Cameroon.
ARCEP Gabon says Gabon and Rwanda officially launched reduced-rate roaming in July 2016.
ARCEP Gabon says Gabon signed a roaming protocol of agreement with Chad in 2021; the free roaming service with Chad was interrupted.
ARCEP Gabon says free roaming between Gabon and Togo went into service in 2022.
